integrity: The supporting free p-convex norm formula is a published premise. The mathematical analysis and finite checker are distinct forms of evidence; bounded enumeration does not prove infinite parameter ranges.
scientific_limitations: Finite simple graphs without isolated vertices, real scalars, finite exponent only; no closed form for general arbitrary graphs beyond vertex-price minimization; independent audit not performed. Vertex-transitive special case follows separately by symmetry.
title: Graph-edge geometric-mean envelopes in free convex Banach lattices
